current.text: Rookie. Milwaukee drafted him 10th overall. He is already 21.
Milwaukee views him as its long-term shooting guard. His game translated in summer league.

Milwaukee's backcourt is crowded. Herro, Rollins, Kevin Porter Jr., Jakucionis, Trent and Green compete with him for guard minutes. The projected opening starters are Rollins, Herro, Jaquez, Kuzma and Turner, so he is not in the starting lineup.
New coach Taylor Jenkins makes the rotation hard to predict. Experts call it the least clear rotation in the league, and he may use a deep rotation.
He has no clear path to minutes and is not expected to play 30 minutes right away. A rank around 240 is reasonable, well below his general ADP of 113.
Milwaukee is expected to focus more on developing young players as the season goes on, which would cut veteran minutes. The roster also needs trades to consolidate its guards and forwards.
Do not draft him in standard leagues. He is a stash option only in stash formats and may get chances in March.
Milwaukee is expected to be a bad team, around 33 wins. It does not own its draft pick.

durable.text: He is a combo guard who plays more like a shooting guard.
He has a flat fantasy profile with no standout skill. He does not bring many defensive stats and is not a passer. Scoring and threes are his main contributions.
In summer league he averaged about 19 points, 4 rebounds, 3.5 assists, 1.8 threes and 1.6 steals. He shot free throws poorly there.
His best case is about 80% of Bradley Beal. He likely needs until his third season to be useful in fantasy.

note: At Yahoo rank 252 and ESPN rank 226, with a 0 USD value on both sites, he falls well outside the 144 players drafted in our league, and the expert says not to draft him in standard leagues. No category is a strong or weak outlier. The two projections disagree on his game: Yahoo has him at 1.3 threes and 2.4 assists, while ESPN has 0.4 threes, 4.1 assists and 2.1 turnovers. That makes him a waiver name, not a punt-build fit. Track his minutes under Jenkins and any Bucks guard trades, since a youth push could give him a role near our fantasy playoffs in March.
